==========================
Coalescing assignment with a clone left side
==========================

<?php
$this->t ??= clone $u ??= Foo::create();

  (php_tag)

          (name))
        (name))

        (augmented_assignment_expression
          (variable_name
            (name))

            (name)
            (name)
            (arguments)))))))

==========================
Assignment chained through clone
==========================

<?php
$a = clone $b = clone $c = make();

---

(program
  (php_tag)
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (variable_name
        (name))
      (clone_expression
        (assignment_expression
          (variable_name
            (name))
          (clone_expression
            (assignment_expression
              (variable_name
                (name))
              (function_call_expression
                (name)
                (arguments)))))))))
